config.farmtweaks.title: Farm Tweaks
config.farmtweaks.features.rightClickHar: Enables right-click harvesting for mature crops.
Applies a Fortune-style bonus to non-seed drops when harvesting with a hoe.
config.farmtweaks.features.aoeHarvest.tt: Enables area harvesting with a hoe (disabled while sneaking).
config.farmtweaks.features.aoeTilling.tt: Enables area tilling with a hoe (disabled while sneaking).
config.farmtweaks.features.seedBags.tt: Enables Seed Bag items and their right-click behavior.
config.farmtweaks.features.xpPerCropEnab: Enables crop XP. When disabled, XP per crop is forced to 0.
config.farmtweaks.features.customWaterHy: Uses FarmTweaks' configured water scan range for farmland hydration.
config.farmtweaks.features.includeWaterl: Allows waterlogged blocks to hydrate farmland within the custom hydration range.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.xpPerCrop.tt: XP awarded per mature crop harvested (disable via the XP rewards feature toggle).
config.farmtweaks.tuning.seedBagAoeShape: Shape used for charged Seed Bag planting: square or radial.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.waterHydrationH: Horizontal distance water can hydrate farmland when custom hydration range is enabled. Vanilla is 4.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.waterHydrationV: Upward vertical distance water can hydrate farmland when custom hydration range is enabled. Vanilla checks 0 and 1.
config.farmtweaks.tuning.aoeTillingCount: Max tilled blocks = 1 + (Efficiency level * this value).
